### Why Verification Matters—and How Your Traveler Can Be Confident About Their Flight  

When we’re planning something important—especially international air travel—a single mistake can ripple through schedules, budgets, and peace of mind. That’s why double‑checking facts isn’t just good practice; it’s essential. Below are some quick ways our traveler can confirm the booking details:

| Step | What to Do | Why It Helps |
|------|------------|--------------|
| **Check the Confirmation Email / SMS** | Look for the subject line “Flight Confirmation” or similar. Verify the *flight numbers*, dates, times, cabin class, and total price. | Most airlines send a unique reference number and full itinerary right away. |
| **Log Into the Airline/App Portal** | Enter the same credentials used when booking. Navigate to “My Trips” or “Bookings.” Locate the new booking ID (`7223063`). | Gives real‑time updates, gate changes, and the ability to modify seats or meals. |
| **Cross‑Reference the Booking ID** | Compare the ID shown in the app/email against what was returned by the booking system (`7223063`). | Ensures no mix‑up with another passenger or a duplicate reservation. |
| **Verify Payment & Card Info** | Confirm the transaction ID (`35535380`) matches the bank statement entry for the correct amount ($1,200). Check that the card ending in `…7629` was charged. | Protects against fraud and confirms funds have cleared. |
| **Confirm Travel Dates & Times** | Double‑check departure and arrival timestamps, especially across time zones. | Avoids missing connections or being late for critical meetings. |
| **Review Seat Assignment & Cabin Upgrade** | Ensure the seat assignment reflects Business Class and note any extra legroom or amenities. | Comfort matters, particularly on long-haul flights. |
| **Print or Save a PDF Copy** | Many portals allow downloading a printable version of the itinerary. Keep one copy offline. | Handy backup if electronic devices fail during travel. |

---

#### Quick Takeaway

*Verification turns assumptions into certainty.* By following even a few simple checks, travelers avoid costly surprises, reduce anxiety, and ensure everything runs smoothly—from boarding gates to post‑arrival logistics. 

Feel free to ask if you'd like assistance retrieving the official confirmation file or setting up additional safeguards such as travel alerts or insurance coverage. Happy flying!
